description: Numeric literals in the corpus that are NEAR a NIST CODATA-2022 table value but not equal to it -- the signature of a stale edition. Sites are split into code_sites (executable, the only class that can compute a wrong number), prose_sites (inside a comment or string, inert -- and often the RESULT of a drain recording what it superseded), adjudicated_sites (executable but marked reviewed), and record_sites (witness/audit output). Quote code_sites as the actionable queue, never source_sites, which is their sum and over-states it ~7x. Complements codata_truncation_audit.py, which compares literals against the in-repo codata_constants module and so catches short prefixes but is structurally blind to a full-length literal from an earlier CODATA edition. Reference values are READ from library/allascii.txt, never typed here.
q0AnchorReason: String/lexical scan of source text against the NIST table. No substrate quantity is evaluated, so no q0 pin is involved.
